plugins.name: wovenflow
plugins.description: Doc-Test-Driven Development (DTDD) — literate-programming-flavored TDD. Five skills: designflow (Design phase — write .spec.md with user stories + ∵ IF / ↦ WHEN / ∴ THEN behaviors, prose only), testflow (Test phase — insert inline test blocks; bundled extractor produces derived test files at pre-test time; 28 built-in languages including typescript/javascript/python/java/kotlin/swift/csharp/cpp/c/php/rust/ruby/go/dart/elixir/clojure/haskell/ocaml/julia/lua/bash/r/sql/graphql + override flags --fence and --name-template for any other language or DSL), subflow (Build phase — dispatch implementer subagents per behavior in parallel git worktrees, with spec-compliance and code-quality review; subagents read .spec.md by file path), researchflow (pre-design phase — bridges the gap between the agent's training cutoff and current reality via web search; surfaces real papers, prior systems, design patterns, current library versions, current API shapes, RFCs, ecosystem conventions before drafting the spec), and setup (interactive workflow wizard — detects existing CLAUDE.md workflow, walks through each phase suggesting skills or crafting custom ones from bundled scaffold templates: claim, startup, verify, ship-pr, ship-direct, wrap-up — covering both PR-based and solo / no-PR workflows; writes settled workflow back to CLAUDE.md).
